title: kith-peer: N-participant group chat delivery (send and receive)
description:
KITH-3yb.9 was closed as done but group chat delivery is not implemented. DeliverHandler computes chatId from exactly 2 participants (hardcoded) and DeliverMessageArgs has no participants field.

Implement:
1. Add participants: Option<Vec<String>> to DeliverMessageArgs (peer-supplied list)
2. In DeliverHandler step 4: if participants present, build all_participants = participants + owner_id, sort, verify sender is in list, compute chatId from sorted list; if not present, fall back to 2-participant (direct chat)
3. In build_peer_deliver_request: add participants: Option<&[String]> parameter; include in request JSON if Some
4. In outbox_tick: load chat participants from store, pass to build_peer_deliver_request if chat.kind == 'group'
5. For group chat fanout: outbox_tick must enqueue one outbox entry per participant (currently only one recipient per message)

Why: Without this, messages in group chats are undeliverable across peers; only owner-authored messages in the local DB reflect group membership.
notes: Part of Phase 2 peer delivery epic KITH-7w7
